text: paṭipuccheyyātha yathā vo bhagavā byākaroti tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthāti . [176] evamāvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu . ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ yaṃ kho no bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho tasmā tiha bhikkhave se āyatane veditabbe yattha cakkhu ca nirujjhati rūpasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe .pe.
